sections.h2: Timberlake Home Prices and Market Pace
sections.html:
In the 24 months from November 15, 2024 to November 14, 2026, 116 residential sales closed in Timberlake (Virginia Beach, VA) according to REIN MLS records. The median sold price was $320,000, below the citywide median of $405,000, and homes took a median of 20 days to sell, about the same pace as the citywide median of 15 days. These figures come from closed sales, which show what homes actually sold for rather than asking prices.

The middle half of Timberlake sales closed between $275,000 and $365,000, or about $212 per square foot against $240 citywide. Split by year, the median sold price in the most recent 12 months ($332,500, 48 sales) was about 4% higher than in the earlier 12 months ($318,750, 68 sales). The typical home sold right at its list price (median sale-to-list ratio of 100%).

Recent Timberlake sales were in ZIP code 23462.

39% of Timberlake homes went under contract within 14 days of listing, compared with 49% of Virginia Beach sales overall. 48% of sales here were detached homes, versus 61% citywide. At a median $212 per square foot, Timberlake sits 11% below the $240 citywide figure.

sections.h2: When Timberlake Homes Sell and How Far Prices Range
sections.html:
Closings in Timberlake were busiest in April (18 sales across the two years) and slowest in February (4 sales). Sold prices ran from $145,000 to $490,700, a spread of 3.4x between the lowest and highest sale. 81% of homes closed at or above list price and 7% closed at least 5% below it.

sections.h2: What Kinds of Homes Sell in Timberlake
sections.html:
48% of the sales were detached homes and 52% were attached homes (townhomes or condos). The median home was about 1,548 square feet, with the middle half of sales running from roughly 1,260 to 1,702 square feet. 43% of the homes that sold had 3 bedrooms.

Most homes that sold were built between 1976 and 1984, with a median year built of 1979, so this is mostly homes from the 1970s through the 1990s.
